events.title: Bingo night
events.text: The community center bingo jackpot hits $800. Your card feels lucky.

effects.tpl: Your number hits without you. You hear about it for weeks.

events.title: Fourth needed
events.text: The community bridge club needs {{s.firstName}} as a fourth. Average age: 74. Stakes: glory.

effects.tpl: Bidding wars, tea, triumph. You are the exciting young one.
You watch quiz shows instead. Peaceful.

events.title: World like wet paint
events.text: {{s.firstName}}'s world smears like wet paint. The eye doctor says: cataracts, both eyes, fixable.

effects.tpl: Colors return in HD. You cry at a sunset.
Steps blur. The stairs negotiate badly.

events.title: Senior cruise!
events.text: A 2-week cruise: $3,500. Buffets, sunsets, shuffleboard glory.

effects.tpl: Dolphins at dawn. You dance like 25.
You stay home and water plants.

events.title: The missing gnome
events.text: The neighbor's hedge invades {{s.firstName}}'s roses — and the prize gnome is MISSING.

effects.tpl: Midnight gnome-napping begins. The street takes sides.
Warm pie thaws cold war. The gnome returns.

events.title: The fall
events.text: A wet floor, a wrong step — your hip sings with pain.

effects.tpl: New hip, slow walks, strong spirit.
It heals crooked. The stairs become mountains.

text.template: {{k?k.name:"Your child"}} starts showing up with groceries, then with schedules, then with That Look doctors get.

effects.tpl: Soup appears. Appointments get kept. Love, reversed, tastes wonderful.
You hide the pill organizer. They find it. Everybody pretends.

events.title: Restructuring
events.text: A letter shrinks {{s.firstName}}'s pension checks 20%. Restructuring, it says. Cheerfully.

effects.tpl: Smaller flat, tidier life. Pride intact.

then.tpl: The protest makes the news. Payouts restored plus $6,000 back-pay!

else.tpl: You lose, but the fight felt righteous.

events.title: Retirement?
events.text: Work offers a retirement package. Pension + watch + cake.

effects.tpl: Standing ovation, gold watch, endless mornings. $25k package.
You stay. The young ones call you legend.

events.title: Grandma? It is me
events.text: A wobbling voice calls {{s.firstName}}: It is me — I am in jail, wire $5,000 NOW, do not tell mom!

effects.tpl: {{s.traits&&s.traits.includes("paranoid")?"Red flags everywhere. Blocked before hello.":"You block the number and warn the bingo group. Hero."}}
Forty minutes of fake confusion. They hang up first. Victory.

then.tpl: Paranoia saves you at the last digit. You freeze the transfer.

else.tpl: It was not family. The shame stings worse than the loss.

events.title: Beach shares
events.text: Four families, one beach house, rotating weeks.

effects.tpl: Your weeks: June. Dawn walks, grandkids, salt air.
Two rented weeks yearly. Sand without the roof.

events.title: Bingo crown
events.text: Friday bingo. Your rival has won thrice running.

then.tpl: Blackout! 200 dollars and the crown returns.

else.tpl: One number short. The rivalry burns beautifully on.

effects.tpl: New dabber, new luck. The table respects the ritual.

events.title: Life list
events.text: The life list stands at 200. The warblers migrate now.

effects.tpl: The painted bunting! Seen, logged, celebrated. 201.
Your local patch yields daily wonders. Depth beats distance.

events.title: Tournament day
events.text: The regional bridge tournament. Your partnership is favored.

effects.tpl: You bid the slam and make it. The room applauds.
Two teens mentored. The game gains a generation.

events.title: Cabin legacy
events.text: The cabin needs a new dock. Grandkids need a summer.

effects.tpl: New dock, cannonballs resumed. Summer: saved.
Pros build, you direct. Supervision is an art.

events.title: Bright again
events.text: Cataracts dim the world. The surgery takes fifteen minutes.

effects.tpl: Colors return like a gift. You read signs a block away.
First eye done. The difference stuns you. Second booked.

events.title: Forty years
events.text: Forty years in the choir. The anniversary anthem features you.

effects.tpl: The solo soars. Forty years in one verse. Tears flow.
You conduct the finale. The choir sways as one.

events.title: Complete the set
events.text: One coin missing since 1979. The auction lists it.

then.tpl: Won! The set completes after 46 years. The case closes with a click.

else.tpl: Outbid at the last second. The hunt continues gloriously.

effects.tpl: The chase was always the point. Almost.

events.title: Center stage
events.text: The community theater needs a lead with gravitas. That is you.

effects.tpl: Opening night standing ovation. The review names you twice.
Your staging stuns. The cast cries at strike.

events.title: Glacier route
events.text: The Alaska cruise brochure has lived on the fridge for years.

effects.tpl: Glaciers calve, whales breach, dinner has a view. Bucket: listed.
September sailing, half price, full glaciers. Wisdom wins.

events.title: World segment
events.text: A world cruise segment: 30 days, six ports.

effects.tpl: Six ports, one suite, endless horizons. The trip of trips.
One region deeply. Enough to dream the rest.

events.title: Golden fifty
events.text: Fifty years. The hall is booked, the band is the original.

effects.tpl: Same dance, slower tempo, deeper meaning. Fifty years.
Dinner for twelve. Every toast lands. Gold glows softly.

events.title: Silver sneakers
events.text: The dance fitness class averages seventy and out-dances all.

effects.tpl: Steps memorized, heart pounding happily. Showcase in spring.
Every song, new partner. The floor is friendship.

events.title: Rightsizing
events.text: The big house echoes. A cottage beckons.

effects.tpl: Equity freed: 80,000 dollars. The cottage fits like a hug.
Two rooms rented to students. Income plus young energy.

events.title: Farewell tour
events.text: The band's farewell tour: three towns, one bus.

effects.tpl: Sold-out finales. You close with the first song you learned.
Single show, packed hall. Perfect ending, no bus.

events.title: Jam legend
events.text: Your jam stall has regulars who plan weeks around it.

effects.tpl: Pickles join the jams. 1,500 dollars of sweet profit.
Free classes monthly. The town preserves because of you.

events.title: Dawn bite
events.text: The lake at 5am. The loons, the mist, the waiting.

effects.tpl: Three bass before breakfast. The day peaks early.
You watch the mist lift. Fish optional, morning perfect.

events.title: Senior derby
events.text: The senior fishing derby: biggest catch, oldest lies.

else.tpl: Stories win; fish abstain. Next year, they say.

effects.tpl: Fry-up for all competitors. Everyone wins lunch.

events.title: Puppy raising
events.text: Guide dog puppies need raisers for a year. Your home qualifies.

effects.tpl: Sunny learns 40 commands, then guides someone. Tears and pride.
Weekend sitting for raisers. Joy without the goodbye.

events.title: Club president
events.text: The garden club elects you president. The gavel is a trowel.

effects.tpl: Shows, sales, tours. Best year in club history.
You advise, others lead. The club blooms anyway.

events.title: Rose wars
events.text: The garden show deadline looms. Your roses are ready.

effects.tpl: Blue ribbon! The trophy rose sits center table.
Fair judging, kind words. Growers respect your eye.

events.title: Ace chase
events.text: Thirty years, no ace. The par-3 seventh keeps winking.

then.tpl: ACE! The ball drops, the patio erupts. Drinks are on everyone but you.

else.tpl: Lipped out again. The chase continues gloriously.

effects.tpl: Closest-to-pin pool funds the lunches. Joy either way.

events.title: Senior tees
events.text: The senior tees shorten the course and lengthen the laughs.

effects.tpl: Handicap drops. The Nassau money funds lunches.
Lunch lasts longer than golf. Friendships deepen.

events.title: Grandkid summit
events.text: Three grandkids, one weekend, your rules.

effects.tpl: Pancakes, forts, fireflies. They chant your name at pickup.
Knots, cards, constellations. Graduation: honorary grandkids.

events.title: Last best trip
events.text: The old crew plans one more wilderness trip.

effects.tpl: Loons, pike, fireside lies. The best one yet.
Cabin base, day trips out. Comfort plus wilderness.

events.title: Great news
events.text: The word arrives: great-grandparent. Say it slowly.

effects.tpl: Four generations in one photo. The frame cannot hold it.
A letter for the future. Sealed, saved, priceless.

events.title: Turn it up
events.text: Everyone mumbles. The test says otherwise.

effects.tpl: Birds return. Conversations return. The world unmutes.
Corners, quiet rooms, facing faces. Tactics work.

events.title: New hardware
events.text: The hip is bone-on-bone. Surgery scheduled spring.

effects.tpl: New hip, new life. Stairs surrender within weeks.
Strong going in, stronger coming out. Recovery: record pace.

events.title: Museum years
events.text: The museum wants guides for the new wing.

effects.tpl: Railroad history, delivered with drama. Visitors linger.
Fourth graders adore you. History lands like stories.

events.title: Balloon dawn
events.text: A balloon festival offers senior flights at dawn.

effects.tpl: Silent over patchwork fields. The burner roars, you soar.
Chase crew: maps, trucks, high fives at landing.

events.title: Letters to tomorrow
events.text: Letters for milestones you may miss: graduations, weddings.

effects.tpl: Sealed, dated, entrusted. Love, scheduled for the future.
Your face telling them proud. Played through tears and laughter.

events.title: Tuesday desk
events.text: The library needs a Tuesday volunteer. The quiet calls.

effects.tpl: Regulars ask for you. The new arrivals shelf glows.
Story hour legend. Toddlers reserve your lap.

events.title: Boot scoot
events.text: Line dancing Tuesdays. Boots optional, joy required.

effects.tpl: Copperhead road mastered. The floor is yours.
Front row, full commitment. Beginners follow your boots.

events.title: Page one
events.text: The stories stack up. The grandkids ask for the book.

effects.tpl: Two hundred pages. The family fights over chapters lovingly.
Your voice telling all. Played at every gathering.

events.title: Season seats
events.text: Season seats, row K, four operas. Culture scheduled.

effects.tpl: Tragedy, comedy, high C. The season nourishes.
Each opera gains a guest. Converts made monthly.

events.title: Silver strings
events.text: The silver orchestra welcomes older beginners. Your violin waits.

effects.tpl: Concert in spring. The harmony swells; so do you.
Folk sessions monthly. Tunes older than the town.

events.title: Paint the light
events.text: The plein air group paints Tuesdays wherever light lands.

effects.tpl: Forty canvases a year. The town hangs your seasons.
Light studies daily. The eye sharpens like a lens.

events.title: The letter
events.text: The pension statement arrives. The number must stretch decades.

effects.tpl: A plan to 95. The number holds with room to spare.
Consulting Fridays. 3,000 dollars extra and purpose kept.

events.title: Travel points
events.text: Points and pensions: the travel math of freedom.

effects.tpl: Points cover flights. 1,200 dollars saved for suites.
One month, one village. Living, not touring.

events.title: Dawn dinkers
events.text: The 7am pickleball crew saves you a court.

effects.tpl: Dinks, drives, laughter. Joints approve; spirits soar.
Fair ladders, fun nights. The crew runs on you.

events.title: Nationals dream
events.text: Regionals won. Nationals in Florida. The team is going.

then.tpl: Quarterfinals at nationals! The team photo glows.

else.tpl: Pool play exit. The experience outshines the record.

effects.tpl: You sponsor the van. The team carries your name.

events.title: Porch coffee
events.text: Retirement mornings: coffee, birds, zero alarms.

effects.tpl: The paper, the porch, the peace. Mornings become sacred.
Two miles before coffee. The day starts victorious.

events.title: Jigsaw trials
events.text: The puzzle championship: 1000 pieces, teams of two.

then.tpl: Third place! Edges first, sky last, glory always.

else.tpl: Half done at the whistle. The rematch brews.

effects.tpl: Fridays, soup, sorting trays. Tradition cements.

events.title: Final stitch
events.text: The quilt begun at forty ends at seventy. One border left.

effects.tpl: Hand-bound, labeled, gifted. Thirty years in every stitch.
Friends gather, stories flow, the binding flies.

events.title: Famous soup
events.text: Your soup wins the block contest three years running.

effects.tpl: The secret revealed at last. Legacy secured in broth.
A new spice blend. Four-peat. The trophy shelf groans.

events.title: Sunrise club
events.text: A club that watches sunrises. That is the whole club.

effects.tpl: Four hundred sunrises. Never the same twice.
Your cocoa fuels the dawn crowd. Attendance triples.

events.title: Silver lanes
events.text: Masters swimming: lanes by pace, coffee after.

effects.tpl: Gold in your age group. The cap barely contains the grin.
Lane four forever. Birthdays celebrated poolside.

events.title: Slow mornings
events.text: The park group flows at 7am. The invitation stands.

effects.tpl: Balance returns. Mornings move like water.
Saturdays suffice. The form still deepens.

events.title: Tech support reverse
events.text: The grandkids teach you the new phone. Roles reverse.

effects.tpl: Video calls, photos, memes. Connected across the miles.
Video calls perfected. That is the whole ballgame.

events.title: Saturn nights
events.text: Retirement telescope: the rings await your driveway.

effects.tpl: Rings, moons, deep sky. Neighbors line up nightly.
Shared domes, shared wonder. The club gains a regular.

events.title: Rail adventure
events.text: Two grandkids, one sleeper train, endless windows.

effects.tpl: Bunk beds rolling through mountains. They talk about it for years.
One scenic day trip. A trial run for the grand tour.

events.title: Rails and peaks
events.text: The glass-domed train crosses the Rockies in daylight.

effects.tpl: Peaks parade past glass. Dinner rolls with the rails.
Fall gold, fewer crowds, same mountains. Wisdom.

events.title: Record the service
events.text: The veterans project records stories before they fade.

effects.tpl: Your story joins the archive. Grandkids listen differently now.
Twenty interviews recorded. History, saved by you.

events.title: Candy striper
events.text: The hospital needs visitors and wheel-pushers.

effects.tpl: Lonely patients light up Thursdays. Purpose, dispensed.
Rides to appointments. Gratitude rides back.

events.title: Trail crew
events.text: The trail crew maintains the ridge you love.

effects.tpl: Drains cleared, bridges sound. Hikers thank the crew.
Monthly guided walks. The ridge gains devotees.

events.title: Slow Europe
events.text: Thirty days, four cities, no rushing. The retirement trip.

effects.tpl: Cafes, cathedrals, hand-holding. The photos glow.
Unpack once, see everything. Elegance floats.

events.title: Tasting crew
events.text: The tasting group meets monthly. Your cellar contributes.

effects.tpl: Ten vintages, one grape. The night educates deliciously.
Barrel rooms and blending trials. Cases shipped home.

events.title: Circle of chairs
events.text: Young parents ask for your counsel monthly. Coffee provided.

effects.tpl: Decades distilled over coffee. Families steadier because of you.
Mostly you listen. That was always the wisdom.

events.title: Apprentice call
events.text: Young makers want your shop wisdom. The lathes wait.

effects.tpl: Twelve apprentices, zero injuries, infinite sawdust.
A cradle for the newest great-grand. Heirloom complete.
